{{Top}}
'''Navigational beacons''' were used to direct [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to destinations within [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="PoG3">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref> They were deployed by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] exploring the frontier to warn of dangerous phenomena in the area, such as [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]].<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref>
